first-law-zero-net.alt: Three objects. A lamp hanging at rest: F_T, cord on lamp, up equals F_g, Earth on lamp, down. A skydiver falling at constant velocity: F_air, air on diver, up equals F_g down. A sled speeding up: F_N and F_g balance, but F_T, rope, to the right is longer than F_f, snow, to the left, so the net force is to the right.
